questions: Did the tremor begin suddenly, over hours or days?
Do your hands tremble when they are completely relaxed and supported?
Is the tremor noticeably worse on one side than the other?
Does it occur in your head or voice as well as your hands?
Is the tremor worse when reaching for or holding objects?
Has the tremor progressively worsened over months or years?
Do close relatives have a similar tremor?
Does drinking alcohol temporarily reduce the tremor?
Have you recently reduced or stopped heavy alcohol use?
Have you started or increased any medication before the tremor began?
Do you use stimulants such as excess caffeine, amphetamines, or cocaine?
Have you developed slowness, stiffness, reduced arm swing, or difficulty initiating movement?
Have you had problems with balance, walking, speech, swallowing, or coordination?
Have you had weakness, numbness, double vision, or a severe new headache?
Have you had weight loss, heat intolerance, sweating, palpitations, or frequent loose stools?
Did the tremor begin before age 40?
Have you ever had liver disease, unexplained psychiatric symptoms, or abnormal involuntary movements?
